mission_priority: XRP intelligence and prediction-engine mastery; Barrot V3 remains the execution, verification and safety foundation.
major_new_finding: The October 29 Binance theft began on XRPL. Five Binance hot wallets sent 233,461,943.1 XRP to attacker account rK21t6nGLy4MNDqhvy3pGwcLFy25qgfzMx between 20:05 and 20:09 UTC. Bitquery's latest reviewed balance is 233,461,943.10005 XRP with no outgoing transaction through 2026-10-31 16:51 UTC. The current state after that is unknown.
institutional_relationships: FBI officially attributed the overall >$6B Binance theft to North Korea's TraderTraitor on October 31.

Circle froze 823M USDC and later 1.56M USDC in attacker-linked addresses; Elliptic reports an attacker AVAX-to-USDC-to-Ethereum path using Circle CCTP. This is not evidence of Circle intentionally assisting.
Ripple froze 40.5M RLUSD on Ethereum after approximately 48M had already been sold; Ripple cannot freeze native XRP.

Binance reports 90% of stolen assets replenished and top-ten assets including XRP and RLUSD 100% backed. This is company-reported customer coverage, not recovery of the stolen XRP or proof of an XRP-specific market purchase.
Binance's latest official notice still only targets withdrawal reopening for Sunday November 1; no confirmed reopening time is recorded.

market_context.caveat: Earlier TradRadar OI was 1.87B; provider scope/timestamps differ. These figures are indicative, not feature-store quality.
